lines.t: Dust motes dancing in a beam of light
The moon is pulling back from the edge of night
Used to walk with heavy, downward eyes
Missing all the glory in the morning rise
But now the silver on the maple leaf
Is cutting through the shadows of my unbelief (shadows)
Every petal, every blade of grass
Is whispering a message as I pass
It’s not just a view, it’s a living word
The clearest voice I’ve ever heard... (I’ve ever heard)
I see Your signature in every vein
In the rhythmic blessing of the summer rain
From the golden hour to the sparrow's wing
I hear the anthem that the heavens sing
You didn’t just build it and walk away
You’re painting the world anew today (painting it new)
I’m standing in the awe, I’m standing in the light
Of the Glory hidden in plain sight
Warmth of the sun on my upturned face
A tactile mercy and a physical grace
The way the tide knows exactly when to turn
Is a lesson that my heart is slow to learn
That the One who hung the stars in empty space
Cares for the wildflower in this lonely place (You care for me)
If You dress the lilies in a royal hue
Then I know I’m never out of sight for You
Yeah, look at the fractal, look at the design
The math of the forest, the curve of the vine
It’s a gallery opening that never shuts down
From the peak of the ridge to the dirt in the town
I see the fingerprints left on the clay
The intention in the whole display (yeah)
It’s the breath in my lungs, the salt in the sea
It’s the wildness of spirit You planted in me
No random collision, no cosmic mistake
But a masterpiece churning in every wake
The mountains are bowing, the cedars are tall
And the God of the cosmos is Lord of it all. (Lord of it all)
If the rocks will cry out, then so will I
If the wind gives You glory, I won't be dry
From the deep of the ocean to the heights of the blue
Everything, everywhere, points back to You! (Back to You!)
I see Your signature in every vein
In the rhythmic blessing of the summer rain
From the golden hour to the sparrow's wing
I hear the anthem that the heavens sing
You didn’t just build it and walk away
You’re painting the world anew today (painting it new)
I’m standing in the awe, I’m standing in the light
Of the Glory hidden in plain sight
In plain sight... (I see You)
Every flower at my feet...
The glory in the small...
I see You in it all.
